Name: No local accounts with blank passwords allowed over network
Description: LimitBlankPasswordUse=1 prevents accounts with blank passwords from being used for network authentication.
Rationale: LimitBlankPasswordUse=1 blocks blank-password accounts from network logon.
Remediation: GPO: Accounts: Limit local account use of blank passwords to console logon only = Enabled. Registry: LimitBlankPasswordUse = 1.

Name: UAC enabled (EnableLUA = 1)
Description: User Account Control restricts all users including admins to standard privileges by default. Disabling UAC removes the last line of defence against privilege escalation.
Rationale: EnableLUA=1 keeps UAC active; disabling it removes the last barrier to silent elevation.
Remediation: GPO: Security Options > User Account Control: Run all administrators in Admin Approval Mode = Enabled. Registry: EnableLUA = 1 (reboot required).

Name: UAC prompts for admin credentials (ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin >= 1)
Description: ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=0 silently elevates without prompting, so any process can gain SYSTEM silently. Must be >= 1 (prompt) or 2 (prompt for credentials).
Rationale: ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=0 elevates silently; >=1 forces a prompt.
Remediation: GPO: Security Options > User Account Control: Behavior of the elevation prompt for administrators. Registry: ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin = 2.
